elements.element: The obligations are triggered upon expiry or termination of the agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must, at Corio’s request, “provide transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six (6) months.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly available “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause specifies “Commerce One’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must return to Corio “all data of Corio and its Customers” in Commerce One’s possession or control.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The return is required “within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires a “standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: After return, Commerce One must “delete such data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor must certify the deletion after it occurs.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must “certify such deletion to Corio in writing” after the data return and deletion.

elements.element: The fallback obligations are triggered upon expiry or termination of the agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 applies upon any expiration or termination.

elements.element: Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Commerce One is obligated to provide transition assistance at Corio’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for ninety (90) days.
elements.evidence: Assistance is available for up to six months, which encompasses the required 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Vendor must export or return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must return all data of Corio and its Customers to Corio.

elements.element: The data export or return must occur within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause requires return within thirty days after expiration or termination.

result.reason: The redline fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It adds only the requested exit mechanics, identifies the responsible and receiving parties, and does not disturb unrelated termination, survival, support, confidentiality, or escrow terms.
